simp.text: 养了一群白白胖胖的羊。

trad.text: 養了一群白白胖胖的羊。
trad.bpmf: 養了一󠇢群白白胖胖的羊。

example.en: He raised a flock of plump, white sheep.

simp.text: 有一只狼闻到羊的味道。

trad.text: 有一隻狼聞到羊的味道。
trad.bpmf: 有一󠇢隻狼聞到羊的味道。

example.en: A wolf smelled the scent of the sheep.

simp.text: 楚襄王每天只知道吃喝玩乐。

trad.text: 楚襄王每天只知道吃喝玩樂。
trad.bpmf: 楚襄王每天只知道吃喝玩樂。

example.en: Every day King Xiang cared only about eating, drinking, and having fun.
Let your old minister tell you a story.
His name was Zhuang Xin.

simp.text: 在一个叫做楚国的地方。

trad.text: 在一個叫做楚國的地方。
trad.bpmf: 在一󠇡個󠇡叫做楚國的地方。

example.en: It was in a place called the Kingdom of Chu.
There was a king named King Xiang.

simp.text: 楚襄王终于知道害怕了。

trad.text: 楚襄王終於知道害怕了。
trad.bpmf: 楚襄王終於知道害怕了。

example.en: At last King Xiang knew what it was to feel afraid.
Be careful of the Kingdom of Qin.
Zhuang Xin received the message.

simp.text: 牧民的邻居听说了这件事。

trad.text: 牧民的鄰居聽說了這件事。
trad.bpmf: 牧民的鄰居聽說了這件事。

example.en: The shepherd's neighbour heard about what had happened.
It smelled the scent of the sheep.
Zhuang Xin felt both angry and disappointed.
The situation is very dangerous.
Zhuang Xin was very anxious.

vocab.en: to fix a problem after a loss so it does not happen again; it is never too late to put a mistake right (literally 'to mend the pen after the sheep are lost')

simp.text: 亡羊补牢，永远都不算晚！

trad.text: 亡羊補牢，永遠都不算晚！
trad.bpmf: 亡羊補牢，永遠都不󠇡算晚！

example.en: Mending the pen after losing the sheep is never too late!

simp.text: 楚国里有一位聪明又善良的大臣。

trad.text: 楚國裡有一位聰明又善良的大臣。
trad.bpmf: 楚國裡有一󠇡位聰明又善良的大臣。

example.en: In Chu there was a clever and kind-hearted minister.
Make preparations early.

simp.text: 楚襄王完全不理会庄辛的警告。

trad.text: 楚襄王完全不理會莊辛的警告。
trad.bpmf: 楚襄王完全不理會莊辛的警告。

example.en: King Xiang ignored Zhuang Xin's warning completely.

simp.text: 楚襄王终于知道害怕了。

trad.text: 楚襄王終於知道害怕了。
trad.bpmf: 楚襄王終於知道害怕了。

example.en: At last King Xiang came to know fear.

simp.text: 后悔自己当初没听邻居的劝告。

trad.text: 後悔自己當初沒聽鄰居的勸告。
trad.bpmf: 後悔自己當初沒聽鄰居的勸告。

example.en: He regretted not listening to his neighbour's advice in the first place.
He did not listen to his neighbour's advice.

simp.text: 现在国家变成这个样子，还能挽救吗？

trad.text: 現在國家變成這個樣子，還能挽救嗎？
trad.bpmf: 現在國家變成這個󠇡樣子󠇡，還󠇡能挽救嗎？

example.en: Now that the country has come to this, can it still be saved?

simp.text: 楚国现在的处境非常危险。

trad.text: 楚國現在的處境非常危險。
trad.bpmf: 楚國現在的處境非常危險。

example.en: The Kingdom of Chu's situation right now is very dangerous.

simp.text: 庄辛收到消息，二话不说。

trad.text: 莊辛收到消息，二話不說。
trad.bpmf: 莊辛收到消息，二話不說。

example.en: When Zhuang Xin got the message, he did not say a second word.
What utter nonsense!

simp.text: 楚国士兵被打得落花流水。

trad.text: 楚國士兵被打得落花流水。
trad.bpmf: 楚國士兵被打得󠇡落花流水。

example.en: The soldiers of Chu were utterly routed.
Only then did the shepherd suddenly realise.

simp.text: 只要现在赶快重整旗鼓。

trad.text: 只要現在趕快重整旗鼓。
trad.bpmf: 只要現在趕快重󠇡整旗鼓。

example.en: As long as we quickly rally and regroup right now.

vocab.en: to turn over a new leaf

example.en: King Xiang thoroughly turned over a new leaf.
